channel.title: ALTRENDAT
channel.description: What the world is searching for, explained with sources

item.title: Eagles sign QB Joe Milton off Cowboys practice squad with Hurts sidelined
item.description: The Philadelphia Eagles signed quarterback Joe Milton from the Dallas Cowboys' practice squad after starting QB Jalen Hurts was ruled out for Week 6 due to a superficial blood clot discovered after their London game against Jacksonville.

item.title: Ballina woman scoops $100 million Powerball jackpot with single winning ticket
item.description: A woman from Ballina, NSW, became Australia's third-biggest lottery winner after matching all seven numbers and the Powerball on Thursday night, crediting the win to a sign from a recently deceased family member.

item.title: Maple Leafs Acquire Forward Aatu Raty From Canucks In Three-Player Trade
item.description: The Toronto Maple Leafs traded forwards Brandon Buhr and Jacob Quillan to the Vancouver Canucks on Thursday in exchange for Aatu Raty.

item.title: Singapore Battles Toxic Haze as Prime Minister Targets Companies Behind Indonesia Fires
item.description: Severe transboundary smoke from Indonesian wildfires has hit unhealthy air quality levels in Singapore, forcing business suspensions and government threats of prosecution.

item.title: Duchess of Sussex Relaunches Public UK Appearances with Nottingham Charity Away Day
item.description: Meghan Markle returned to Nottingham for her first joint UK engagement in years, visiting local charities and meeting with volunteers.

item.title: False alarm at Miami University: gunfire reports turn out to be fireworks
item.description: Miami University issued an active threat alert Thursday afternoon after reports of gunfire near McGuffey Hall, but police gave the all-clear after confirming the noise came from fireworks with no injuries.

item.title: Benfica Routs Celtic 4-1 as Scottish Champions Struggle in Europe League
item.description: Celtic remain winless in the Europa League after suffering a 4-1 defeat away to Benfica in Lisbon.

item.title: Prime Minister Mark Carney Warns Foreign Nations Against Meddling In Alberta Referendum
item.description: Prime Minister Mark Carney urges Albertans to vote in the upcoming October 19 referendum to ensure the integrity of the process against foreign interference.

item.title: Two-time World Series champion Miguel Rojas retires following Dodgers championship series loss
item.description: Veteran infielder Miguel Rojas announced his retirement after the Los Angeles Dodgers were eliminated from the National League Championship Series on Thursday.

item.title: Math Professor Hannah Fry Deploys High-Stakes Double Bluff on The Celebrity Traitors
item.description: Professor Hannah Fry is utilizing a sophisticated double bluff strategy to avoid banishment on the second series of The Celebrity Traitors.

item.title: West Ham routs nine-man Lincoln 6-0 in dominant EFL Championship victory
item.description: West Ham United defeated Lincoln City 6-0 on Tuesday after the hosts received two early red cards.

item.title: Rays and Guardians clash in pivotal tied ALCS Game 3 showdown
item.description: The Tampa Bay Rays and Cleveland Guardians face off in a tied ALCS Game 3 this Thursday afternoon in Cleveland.

item.title: Philadelphia Eagles bench quarterback Jalen Hurts after blood clot movement detected
item.description: Jalen Hurts will miss the upcoming game against the Panthers following medical findings regarding a small blood clot in his calf.

item.title: Sunderland returns to Europe for first time in 53 years against Torreense
item.description: Sunderland faces Torreense in the Europa League on Thursday night for their first European competitive match in 53 years.

item.title: Over 150 Schools Receive Bomb Threat Emails Across Dublin And Kildare Regions
item.description: Gardaí are currently assessing the credibility of threatening emails sent to over 150 schools on Wednesday while officials advise normal operations.

item.title: Late Jack Bostock try clinches Australia 24-22 comeback win over New Zealand
item.description: Australia defeated New Zealand 24-22 in the opening match of the 2026 Rugby League World Cup following a decisive 75th-minute try.

item.title: Leaders Clash Over $13.8 Billion Deficit In Only B.C. Provincial Debate
item.description: BC NDP leader David Eby, BC Conservative leader Lorne Doerkson, and BC Green Party leader Emily Lowan faced off in Wednesday's only scheduled election debate.

item.title: Tennessee Powerball player snatches $150,000 prize after opting for 3X Power Play
item.description: A Nashville Powerball player won $150,000 in the Monday drawing by matching four white-ball numbers and the Powerball.

item.title: 89th-minute Rudiger winner completes Real Madrid's 4-3 comeback at Roma
item.description: Real Madrid scored three goals in the final eight minutes to defeat Roma 4-3 in a Champions League group stage match at the Stadio Olimpico, with Antonio Rudiger volleying the winner in the 89th minute.

item.title: James Talarico leads Republican Ken Paxton in competitive Texas US Senate race
item.description: Democratic nominee James Talarico is currently holding a narrow lead over Republican Ken Paxton as he campaigns for a Texas Senate seat.

item.title: Museum drawer fossil identified as new 120 million-year-old feathered dinosaur species
item.description: Researchers have identified Invictibellatrix amberina, a new megaraptoran species found in an Isle of Wight fossil collection after being overlooked for nearly 100 years.

item.title: Heavy rainfall surges through Awakino Gorge forcing highway down to single lane
item.description: Flooding on State Highway 3 in the Awakino Gorge reduced the route to one lane today following intense rainfall.

item.title: PSG storms Etihad as holders topple Manchester City in 4-2 thriller
item.description: Paris Saint-Germain secured a 4-2 victory over Manchester City in a Champions League clash featuring a brace from Erling Haaland.

item.title: Germán Berterame strikes early as Inter Miami shuts out New York City
item.description: Inter Miami secured a 2-0 victory over New York City FC on Wednesday after an opening goal from Germán Berterame.

item.title: Erling Haaland Chases Champions League Record Against Visiting Paris Saint-Germain Tonight
item.description: Manchester City hosts Paris Saint-Germain in tonight's Champions League clash with Erling Haaland aiming to become the club's all-time top scorer in the competition.

item.title: Vinicius Suspended Four Games as Real Madrid Braces for El Clásico
item.description: The Spanish Football Federation has suspended Real Madrid forward Vinicius Junior for four LaLiga matches, ruling him out for the October 25th El Clásico.

item.title: Barcelona Routs Galatasaray 4-1 To Clinch 10th Straight Win In All Competitions
item.description: FC Barcelona defeated Galatasaray 4-1 in Istanbul to maintain a perfect winning streak across all tournaments this season.

item.title: Tsimikas captains Liverpool in Austria for Champions League clash at LASK
item.description: Liverpool made four changes for its Champions League match against LASK in Austria, with Kostas Tsimikas taking the captain's armband and Jeremie Frimpong, Trey Nyoni, and Rio Ngumoha entering the starting lineup.

item.title: Canada's Lotto Max jackpot surges to record $90 million for Friday's draw
item.description: The Lotto Max jackpot has reached a record-breaking $90 million after the previous $85 million top prize went unclaimed in Tuesday's draw.

item.title: Miguel Cardoso welcomes back winger Monnapule Saleng following exile for disciplinary issues
item.description: Mamelodi Sundowns head coach Miguel Cardoso has reintegrated Monnapule Saleng into the first-team squad after the winger completed a period of training in isolation.

item.title: Lamine Yamal Smashes Champions League Records Before Turning 20 Years Old
item.description: Barcelona teenager Lamine Yamal hit 25 Champions League goal contributions during a 4-1 victory against Galatasaray.

item.title: Fastball Freddy Silences Guardians as Rays Clinch Crucial ALCS Game 2 Win
item.description: Freddy Peralta tossed six scoreless innings to lead the Tampa Bay Rays to a 3-1 victory over the Cleveland Guardians, evening the series at 1-1.

item.title: Guardians seize 1-0 series lead by crushing Rays in ALCS opener
item.description: The Cleveland Guardians took a 1-0 lead in the American League Championship Series after defeating the Tampa Bay Rays 7-3 in Game 1.

item.title: Guillermo Rodriguez Snatches Early Exit During First Ever Super Bowl Night
item.description: Guillermo Rodriguez and pro partner Witney Carson were eliminated from season 35 of Dancing With the Stars following a salsa performance.

item.title: Golden State Warriors Cruise Past Lakers in 101-89 Preseason Win at T-Mobile
item.description: The Golden State Warriors defeated the Los Angeles Lakers 101-89 at T-Mobile Arena on Tuesday night.

item.title: Singapore Haze Persists as PSI Levels Hit Unhealthy 144 in West
item.description: Singapore air quality remained in the unhealthy range on Wednesday morning with PSI readings peaking at 144 in the western region.

item.title: Captain Connor McDavid hits milestone 800th career game for Edmonton Oilers
item.description: Connor McDavid reaches his 800th NHL regular-season game tonight as the Oilers look to sweep their three-game California road trip.

item.title: Arsenal blows Lille away with dominant 3-0 Champions League home victory
item.description: Arsenal secured a convincing 3-0 win against Lille at Emirates Stadium in their latest Champions League league-phase fixture.

item.title: Double Departure Rocks Great British Bake Off During Demanding Bread Week Challenge
item.description: Molly was eliminated and Nikki exited for personal reasons during Tuesday's episode.

item.title: Pirates hunt first place as Galaxy seeks turnaround after three-game drought
item.description: Orlando Pirates host TS Galaxy on Tuesday at Orlando Amstel Arena as league football resumes following a three-week international break, with Pirates sitting second on 19 points and Galaxy winless in their last three outings.
